title: Covering design C(21,8,3,4)
statement: Find 8-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 21} such that every 4-subset meets some block in at least 3 points, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 16 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 8 distinct points from 1..21 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(21,8,3,4) = 16 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-26 (before it 17); read 6 Nov 2026

provenance.revision: repository read on the date given

score: the number of blocks (smaller is better)
quantavane_note: our object is the best known entry of the source table
